content:
ashwin: Quick handoff for my shift — heads-up on a few customer-impact risks over the next 12h. I'll be OOO at 13:30 UTC, maria will cover after a 30m overlap. TL;DR: VIP customer 'OpalRetail' has a planned traffic ramp tonight, cert rotation window at 03:00 UTC, and a fallback model variant needs verification.

maria: got it — thanks. i'll join overlap at 13:00 UTC. can you drop runbook links? :thumbsup:

ashwin: runbooks below. main action items in the code block. if anything unclear ping me or @kevin for infra-level concerns.

```
- Verify canary pool capacity for opalretail (route: region-eu, model: gptx-8q)
- Watch for 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m on /v1/generate
- Confirm cert rotation completes by 03:15 UTC and post status in this thread
- If latency p95 > 600ms for >10min: failover to gptx-8q-lowmem and notify customer SRE channel
- Escalation: page oncall-sre if outage, otherwise @julia for SLA exceptions
```

ashwin: links: runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/opalretail-ramp, metrics dashboard: https://dash.redwood/opalretail, cert task: https://infra.tasks/CRT-442.

kevin: noted. infra will standby for cert rotation. i'll pre-warm the fallback pool at 02:30 UTC. will post confirmation here.

maria: thanks — one quick Q: do we have KV cache warming enabled for this customer? last time it caused a spike on first 2k requests.

ashwin: yes, cache warming enabled but limited to 100 prefixes/min. we discussed bumping it for tonight but decided against due to DB load. monitor cache miss rate > 30% and call it out.

julia: i'll be on-call for SLA comms. what is the contract window?

ashwin: OpalRetail has a 99.9% uptime SLA, 200ms p95 target for read-only endpoints, and contractual penalty clauses if we miss total uptime monthly. so prioritize availability > perf.

maria: copy. i'll keep the team posted. if we see sustained errors i'll open an incident-priority thread and start mitigation steps.

sre-bot: Reminder: scheduled cert rotation for opalretail on region-eu at 03:00 UTC (CRT-442). Automated rollback window: 03:30 UTC.

kevin: pre-warm done at 02:32 UTC — fallback pool at 20% capacity. posting to infra-runbook channel as well.

maria: overlap check-in: i've validated routes, healthchecks are green, sample traffic to canary looks stable. will monitor from 12:45-13:15 UTC during overlap.

ashwin: perfect. leaving precise pager instructions in the runbook: page oncall-sre -> severity 2 if >10% errors or >30min sustained latency; page oncall-incident -> severity 1 if data loss or complete outage.

julia: noted. i'll prep a short customer message template in case we need to notify OpalRetail PS/SRE.

maria: thanks all. i'll update this thread with any alerts. good handoff. :pray:
